headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ALO (5)

summary: Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 4.4s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Oliver Bearman made the biggest climb, from P22 to P16.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised SAI (5 second time penalty) and GAS (5 second time penalty).
There were 25 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 81 points over George Russell.
